`media-codecs.js` is generated by `npm run build:media-codecs` from the pinned
**jpeg-js 0.4.4**, **fast-png 8.0.0**, **iobuffer 6.0.1**, and **fflate 0.8.3**
packages. `node tools/build-media-codecs.mjs --check` verifies reproducibility.

Vapor's App bundler does not convert jpeg-js's CommonJS/browser-global export;
its wrapper is replaced with an ES module export. Android's runtime supports
only UTF-8 in `TextDecoder`, so fast-png's Latin-1 PNG text helper maps bytes to
characters directly. Image decoding algorithms are unchanged. The bundle uses
fflate's browser entry and requires no Node.js modules or global polyfills.

`jpeg-js-LICENSE.txt` contains its BSD-3-Clause distribution license.
notmasteryet's JPEG decoder is licensed under Apache-2.0 (see `Apache-2.0.txt`,
Copyright 2011 notmasteryet). Each other package's MIT license is included in
its named license file. See [jpeg-js](https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js/tree/v0.4.4)
and [fast-png](https://github.com/image-js/fast-png).

Production calls decode only native 32×32 thumbnails with typed-array output,
a 0.02-megapixel input limit and an 8 MiB decoder allocation limit.
